text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When you identify bugs in your code, you should follow a systematic approach instead of guessing. First, try to understand what the program is actually doing and where the problem appears. Debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, can help you find the exact line that causes the issue. Logging is also very useful because it records what happens while the program runs. By reading the logs, you can see where things go wrong. Remember to test one change at a time and keep notes, so you don't repeat the same mistakes. With patience and good habits, debugging becomes much easier.
